zplpInputDirectory.description: The relative file path to the input .zplp files.

isDevelopment.description: If this is set to true, the placeholder values will be used in the generated ZPL code, and a PNG file will be generated with the example label.

pngOutputDirectory.description: The relative directory path where generated PNGs should be saved.

zplOutputDirectory.description: The relative directory path where generated ZPLs should be saved.

inputFileName.description: The name of the input ZPLP file.

showBoundaryBox.description: Determines whether to show the boundary box as defined by the MARGINS in the file. This flag will only be relevant if `isDevelopment` is true.
